Dear Jessamine,

I read about Somewhere, your Lilliput debut, and was struck by your decision never to name the city Clodagh drifts through, even as the housing crisis and addiction press in from every side. Telling the story through Seamus, Sylvia and the wider circle of friends rather than one guiding voice feels like a poet's choice too.

After twenty years of poetry, what did fiction let you do that a poem would not, and why did keeping the place unnamed matter to you?

The Author Ledger is an independent project featuring short Author Spotlights. Each portrait is built from a few written questions you can answer at your own pace, and you see the full text for review before anything is published.

Would you be open to taking part?

Best regards,
The Author Ledger
